title: A correction from the matrix's saved-value editor or the Lp(a) check carries no erase: it rides on the store's erase mark
evidence: Done 2026-11-25. PR 2070 passed the erase from the editor (MatrixSavedCells opened state, LpaChecks press); CorrectFn's erase is now required (lib/matrix-save.ts) and routeTasksToSaves takes a correction already bound to its erase. R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands). Before: Root fix R5 (triage 2026-11-25): every store write takes its erase as a required argument, then the store mark goes. Partial 2026-11-25 (PR 2070): components/MatrixSavedCells.tsx (the editor's effect) and components/LpaChecks.tsx pass getShownErase() to onCorrect; CorrectFn's erase is still optional (lib/matrix-save.ts). Test: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts (pin), MatrixSavedCells.page-hide.test.tsx; HealthTool.erase-commit.test.tsx row "a correction from the matrix's saved-value editor". Left: erase-by-type steps 3 and 4 make the erase required by the type, then the mark leaves health-core.
